target_contract.forward_window: target starts strictly at t+1 minute
target_contract.continuity: exact +60s same-segment only; no gap crossing

scoring.probability_model: empirical categorical distribution with fixed Laplace smoothing
scoring.supported_n0: delta_log_loss > 0 in F1,F2,F3 AND pooled delta_brier > 0
scoring.refuted_n0: pooled delta_log_loss <= 0 OR delta_log_loss <= 0 in at least 2 of F1,F2,F3

hypotheses.causal_definition: known calendar hour America/New_York at t
hypotheses.statement: NY hour provides out-of-fold information about the next-15m volatility distribution beyond the unconditional baseline.
NY weekday provides incremental out-of-fold information about next-15m volatility beyond NY hour.

hypotheses.causal_definition: RV15 ending at t; LOW/MID/HIGH thresholds learned on training fold only
hypotheses.statement: Current absolute volatility state provides incremental out-of-fold information about next-15m volatility beyond hour+weekday.

hypotheses.causal_definition: RV15 ending at t divided by training-only NY-hour median; LOW/MID/HIGH training tertiles
hypotheses.statement: Hour-relative volatility state provides incremental out-of-fold information about next-15m volatility beyond hour+weekday.

hypotheses.causal_definition: mean spread over t-4..t, normalized by training-only NY-hour median; LOW/MID/HIGH training tertiles
hypotheses.statement: Recent relative spread state provides incremental out-of-fold information about next-15m spread distribution beyond hour+weekday.

hypotheses.causal_definition: mean tick_count over t-4..t, normalized by training-only NY-hour median; LOW/MID/HIGH training tertiles
hypotheses.statement: Recent relative tick-density state provides incremental out-of-fold information about next-15m activity beyond hour+weekday.

hypotheses.causal_definition: REOPEN=0; EARLY=1..15; POST=16..60; MATURE>60, fixed before results
hypotheses.statement: Reopen/early-segment state provides incremental out-of-fold information about near-future market-environment distributions.

hypotheses.causal_definition: efficiency15 ending at t; LOW/MID/HIGH thresholds learned on training fold only
hypotheses.statement: Current path-efficiency state provides incremental out-of-fold information about next-15m path efficiency beyond hour+weekday.

promotion_sequence: CR2 bounded regime-candidate synthesis only from CR1-supported axes
separate confirmatory charter on new/pristine data before any validated regime claim
expert/strategy research only after later explicit gate
